Legacy campaign

First Light (1882–1901)

It's 1882. You own one small coal plant and sell electricity to 100 customers. Can you get their payments to cover the cost of keeping the plant running?

Open the Legacy campaign↗ Your decisions ↓

Play the chapters in order. You carry the same utility from one generation to the next.

Location
A fictional California utility
Starts in
1882
Generation
20 years

Your starting point

First Light begins the Legacy campaign in a fictional California utility. You'll run the same company from 1882 to 2061, handing it on after each twenty-year term.

Your first deadline is four years away. By then, electricity sales need to cover your operating costs. After that, you'll have a growing customer base to supply.

Learn how to play

Your decisions

  1. 01

    Set your first price

    How much do you need to charge to pay the coal bill? Watch what happens to your customer count as you change the rate.

  2. 02

    Consider river power

    A small hydro site becomes available in 1895. Compare what it costs to build with the coal you could save.

  3. 03

    Plan the first handover

    The next generation starts with your customers and equipment. It also takes over any debt you leave behind.

What kind of company will those first 100 customers help you build?
